source.models: Kit_EvacPlacard / Kit_EvacPlacardLens rebuilt 2026-10-08 from Tools/Blender/frontrooms_kit/assets/evac_placard*.py (fix stage: frame slot Prop_AluminiumAnodised) into the clone W/proj_placard_fix (main 22bb75f + the Q16 package); art v2 (2026-10-07) packed to 4096 x 2048

conventions.pngPerSheetPx: PNG px = 2 x sheet px; place each PNG at 50 % so the sheet reads at sheetPpm
conventions.groundLine: Part-frame kit: drawn about its origin (the wall-face point at the frame centre, +Z out of the wall), not on a floor. aboveFloor_m = the frame bottom in the game (centre 1.560 m).
conventions.views: third-angle: front = camera on +Z (the printed face), side = the kit's right (camera on -X), top = from above with the front toward the image bottom, persp = 3/4 hero from the front-left, 22 deg up, 1152 x 864
conventions.swatchRule: hex = sRGB of ( linear(mean of the _BaseMap's sRGB pixels) x linear(_BaseColor) ), read from Resources/Surfaces/<slot>.mat in the render clone (interactables/threeview/tools/swatch.py)

sheets.title: Evacuation plan
sheets.lede: A 17 x 11 in plan in a 1 in clear-anodised snap frame by the start door; its legend glows faintly when the lamp dies.

era.label: Period
era.note: Aluminium snap frames are US products from 1977 (MDI US 4,145,828); the tamper-proof bullnose rail is the 1983 type (US 4,519,152). The plan inside is screen-printed and dated PRINTED 03/90. No period photo of one on an office wall yet (media_candidates.md M1–M5 wait for Red).

materials.name: Prop_AluminiumAnodised
materials.label: Clear-anodised aluminium
materials.source: Resources/Surfaces/Prop_AluminiumAnodised.mat: no base map x _BaseColor (0.91, 0.92, 0.92); metallic 1, smoothness 0.62 (placard-only slot, 35_fix §4)

materials.name: Prop_EvacPlan
materials.label: Printed plan (paper)
materials.source: Resources/Surfaces/Prop_EvacPlan.mat: mean of Prop_EvacPlan_A.png (art v2, 4096 x 2048) x _BaseColor white (tint sRGB->linear, product -> sRGB)

materials.name: Prop_EvacPlan (glow)
materials.label: Phosphor legend (dark)
materials.source: FrontRoomsPhosphor.TintLinear = sRGB (0.78, 0.95, 0.58), the ZnS:Cu ink; only the head, labels and changed bands glow, gated by the cell lamp

materials.name: Prop_LensNonGlare
materials.label: Non-glare lens (clear)
materials.source: Resources/Surfaces/Prop_LensNonGlare.mat: URP Lit transparent, black base at alpha 0.04 (preserve specular): reads as clear

members: start door, map side: P1 facade 76 %, P2 side wall 22 %, P3 past the pier 2 % (400 runs)

tris.note: LOD1 106 and LOD2 26 tris are built and reviewed; the FBX holds LOD0 until kitlib.make_lods (P-1) lands

sheets.pending: The legend swatches are in the WP03 reference colourway (pink/grey); 平面视觉 has a request to redraw them in the game colourway (placard 42_request_graphic.md). Re-render this sheet if the art changes.
